Fiona: flagging minor regression on long-summary holdouts for ember-6b-q3 (new layout). F1 down ~2.4, a few hallucinations on legal clauses. suspect promptbank dupes + smart-quote normalization.

Luca: can you paste a failing example and the quant flags?

Fiona: sample: 
```
Prompt: long compliance section (~3k tokens) -> 5 bullet actions
Gold: mentions retention, breach reporting, contact points
Ember out: invents clause about \"selling telemetry\" to vendors
```
Flags: q3-layout + per-layer-scale=0.1. canary id ember-canary-20240901. CSV uploaded: /internal/curation/tmp/ember_fails.csv

Hana: first checks: (1) dedupe with promptbank (paraphrase collisions), (2) tokenization normalization (curly vs straight quotes), (3) truncation leading to shifted context.

Luca: run this locally to triage dedupe:
```bash
python tools/curation/dedupe_scan.py \
  --bank /data/promptbank/2024-09 \
  --targets /internal/curation/tmp/ember_fails.csv \
  --tokenizer-check normalize-quotes \
  --sim-threshold 0.88
```
Outputs candidate anchor ids + sim scores.

labeling-bot: @Hana micro-golden tasks created: 12 tasks (priority: high). ETA ~30h.

Hana: will prioritize annotators on (a) model-origin hallucination vs (b) provenance mismatch vs (c) tokenization-only diffs. If >25% model-origin we block rollout.

Luca: on quant side i'll try kv_norm=true and headroom=0.14. will post a tiny perf/quality matrix tonight. kv_norm typically regains low-prob mass but adds latency.

Fiona: quick eval diffs vs float16 baseline:
- F1: baseline 42.8 -> q3 40.4 (-2.4)
- anchor-precision: 0.86 -> 0.81
- hallucination heuristic: +0.05
Link: https://internal.eval/ember/canary-20240901 (internal)

Luca: provisional action items:
- @Hana complete micro-golden (12) and report confirmed model hallucination fraction -> due +36h (1777032960)
- @Luca post perf/quality table for profiles [q3-default, q3+kv_norm, q3+headroom0.14] -> due +24h (1777020000)
- @Fiona run dedupe_scan and share percent collisions vs anchors -> due +12h (1777014400)
- If dedupe collisions >10% treat as promptbank issue; expand micro-golden to 50 only if collisions <10% and ambiguous fraction >30%.

ops-bot: canary snapshot saved: ember-20240901-snap1. traffic set to 0% pending triage.

Hana: ack. starting micro-golden now. i'll tag confirmed items and mark those that look tokenization-only.

Fiona: thanks. leaning conservative: block until either quant tweak recovers quality without >10ms/token penalty OR we confirm promptbank fault. ping in-thread for updates.
